title: A Harbor for the Tide
author: Sable Okafor
blurb: Ansel Marchetti, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
